confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the issue is almost certainly worn drum support rollers or a dry idler pulley'; also 'confirms there is friction in the drum support system'

rationale: The assistant reached a reasonable engineer escalation, which suits a customer who cannot tilt the machine. However, it became overconfident ('almost certainly', 'confirms') on a slightly rough drum turn, and it skipped simple checks the customer could do: levelling (the machine rocks on one corner), localising the noise, and the cold-morning pattern. It also did not rule out the condensate pump. It also said 'we won't be able to do any further internal checks' and did not explain that the model number could be passed to an engineer. It then declined the model-number part check awkwardly after prompting for the model.
